title: pi.decisions.response.v1
description: Sidecar -> backend normalized response, per docs/PI/pi_jev_implementierungsplan_de.md section 3.3. Provider JSON is untrusted input; decisionsService.ts must reject anything that does not already satisfy this shape (unknown candidate_id, non-finite/out-of-range probabilities) before this object is ever constructed.

model_reported.description: Version the provider actually reported, if any; null (not the requested alias) when absent.

probabilities.description: candidate_id -> raw probability as reported by the provider. Every value must be finite and in [0,1]; a response containing NaN/Infinity anywhere is rejected wholesale, not clamped.

noul_answers.description: Independent scenario/noul-question answers, only meaningful when evidence for them exists (pi_jev_decisions_plan_de.md section 3).

error_code.description: Present when status != ok; a stable application error code, never a raw provider error string.
